cases.name: empty
cases.why: an empty file is the defaults, not an error

cases.name: preset_only
cases.why: the one preset carrying both a mass-model and a performance calibration; naming it must apply both, as the graphical front end does on selection

cases.name: preset_then_field
cases.why: one field of one nested group laid over a preset: everything else in that group stays at the preset's value rather than reverting

cases.name: tuple_field_from_a_list
cases.why: YAML has no tuples, so a tuple-valued field arrives as a list and is re-tupled against the declared value

cases.name: airports
cases.why: the route endpoints are saved with the configuration so a reloaded file reproduces the same route

cases.name: unknown_preset
cases.why: an unregistered preset is swallowed rather than raised -- and the overlay then writes the unknown name into the field anyway, which is reproduced rather than tidied up

cases.name: deep_partial
cases.why: two unrelated groups patched at different depths in one file
